paper_id: Achieving Adaptation for Adaptive Systems via Runtime Verification_ A Model-Driven Approach
title: Achieving Adaptation for Adaptive Systems via Runtime Verification: A Model-Driven Approach
motivation: Self-adaptive systems需要自动在运行时调整行为,但在变化环境中确保NFRs(可靠性、性能)面临挑战。
problem_framing: 将需求工程阶段的静态目标模型与动态运行时自适应相桥接,需建模适应机制并支持NFR验证决策。
key_insight: verification is used as the decision-making process—verification results直接筛选候选适应方案
method_signature: MAPE目标模型→CSP行为模型→变种DTMC/CTMC→PCTL/CSL验证→最优适应决策
evaluation_criteria: 通过PRISM模型检验验证5类NFRs后逐步削减备选方案直至唯一最优解
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 未讨论self-protecting场景,且假设系统离散化处理连续属性
evidence_for_taste: verification processes serve as the decision-making unit
model is more concise but easier to be manipulated
verification is used as a decision-making method
thinking_moves: 把验证从后验确认重框为决策生成机制
用CSP算子建立目标模型到行为模型的映射模式
DTMC/CTMC的变种状态表示候选决策路径
MAPE控制环作为建模元素直接嵌入需求模型
cites_own_work: Z. Yang, Z, Jin, Modeling and specifying parametric adaptation mechanism for self-adaptive systems, Springer, 2014
